name: driver-signal-quality
description: Differential driver into the ratified 50 pF test load: rise/fall time, rise/fall matching, output crossover voltage, and full-speed signal quality (spec/usb2-device-phy.md §6, §8.2).
claim: spec/usb2-device-phy.md#6-driver-characteristics -- rise time 4-20 ns, fall time 4-20 ns, rise/fall matching within 10 %, crossover voltage 1.3-2.0 V, all into the ratified 50 pF test load; and spec/usb2-device-phy.md#82-what-gets-measured-and-against-which-section rows 'Rise/fall time', 'Crossover voltage' and 'Full-speed signal quality'.
derive: meas tran t_rise TRIG v(dp) VAL=$&v10 RISE=1 TARG v(dp) VAL=$&v90 RISE=1
meas tran t_fall TRIG v(dp) VAL=$&v90 FALL=1 TARG v(dp) VAL=$&v10 FALL=1
meas tran t_xr WHEN v(dp)=v(dm) RISE=1
meas tran t_xf WHEN v(dp)=v(dm) FALL=1
meas tran t_xlast WHEN v(dp)=v(dm) CROSS=LAST
meas tran v_xr FIND v(dp) AT=$&t_xr
meas tran v_xf FIND v(dp) AT=$&t_xf

trise_ns.description: spec §6: rise time 10-90 %, 4-20 ns into the 50 pF test load

tfall_ns.description: spec §6: fall time 90-10 %, 4-20 ns into the 50 pF test load

trf_ratio.description: spec §6: rise/fall time matching, within 10 % of each other (t_rise/t_fall in [0.9, 1.1])

vcross_rise.description: spec §6: output signal crossover voltage 1.3-2.0 V, measured on the D+ rising transition

vcross_fall.description: spec §6: output signal crossover voltage 1.3-2.0 V, measured on the D+ falling transition

xing_extra_ps.description: spec §8.2 full-speed signal quality: single zero crossing per transition. The stimulus has exactly two differential transitions, so the LAST D+/D- crossing must be the same event as the falling-transition crossing; any extra crossing (ringing, a non-monotonic edge) moves t_xlast later and shows up here as a positive number of picoseconds

dp_over_mv.description: spec §8.2 full-speed signal quality: monotonic transition, no overshoot above the rail beyond 50 mV of numerical settling

dp_under_mv.description: spec §8.2 full-speed signal quality: monotonic transition, no undershoot below ground beyond 50 mV of numerical settling
